Venha trabalhar com a gente e vamos, juntos, tornar os seguros mais acessíveis à população brasileira!

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Senior Java Developer - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • More than 10 years as a Back-End Developer with Java;
  • Experience with the latest versions of Java;
  • Solid experience with Spring Boot, Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, GraphQL and GitHub;
  • Work experience with Microsoft Cloud Azure;
  • Fluency in English (B2+) - Mandatory ;
  • Willing to move to Portugal with our support.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Desenvolvedor de front-end
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver e manter arquiteturas frontend escaláveis, seguras e de alta performance
  • Definir e implementar padrões e melhores práticas para pipelines de CI/CD e ferramentas de frontend
  • Garantir performance, otimização e resiliência de aplicações web
  • Implementar estratégias de monitoramento, observabilidade e resolução eficiente de incidentes
  • Colaborar com equipes de produto, DevOps e engenharia para difundir boas práticas e liderar iniciativas técnicas


O que você precisa ter

  • Inglês avançado para comunicação (Será testado)
  • React ou Next.js
  • Consumo de APIs
  • Plataformas de E-commerce (SAP CC, Magento, Miraki e Salesforce Comerce Cloud)
  • Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure)
  • Docker e Kubernetes


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Senior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


Step into the world of advanced software engineering as our Senior Python Developer, where you'll architect sophisticated solutions for global clients. This isn't just about coding, it's about leading technical initiatives, mentoring rising talent, and solving complex challenges using Python's powerful ecosystem while driving innovation in cloud environments, data processing, and web development.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Develop data integration services that accelerate customer onboarding processes.

- Ensure reliability, performance, and support of data infrastructure with solutions aligned to application needs and growth projections.

- Lead the design and implementation of complex Python applications.

- Guide junior developers through comprehensive code reviews and technical mentoring.

- Architect scalable solutions using modern design patterns and industry best practices.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to transform business requirements into technical specifications.

- 5+ years of hands-on experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience with SQL and NoSQL Databases.

- Experience with Microservices and Cloud environments.

- Advanced algorithm knowledge.

- Intermediate agile methodologies management.

- Strong understanding of best practices, SOLID principles, CLEAN Code, and scalable solutions.

- Design Patterns knowledge.

- Experience developing entire applications from scratch.

- Experience in automated tests, CI/CD pipelines.

- Strong experience with version control.

- Strong experience with Unit testing, integration testing, and code coverage.

- Advanced English proficiency.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
SRE (Site Reliability Engineer) + DevOp:

Localização: Remoto

Tipo de Contrato: CLT


Descrição da Vaga:

Buscamos um profissional SRE com habilidades em DevOps para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, disponibilidade e desempenho das nossas aplicações e infraestrutura. Este profissional atuará em colaboração com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para promover uma cultura de automação e melhoria contínua.


Responsabilidades:

- Garantir a disponibilidade e a performance das aplicações e serviços, monitorando métricas e implementando soluções proativas.

- Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento para criar e implementar práticas de DevOps, como CI/CD (Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua).

- Automatizar processos de infraestrutura utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible ou similares.

- Implementar e gerenciar ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (como Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, etc.).

- Responder a incidentes e realizar análises de causa raiz para melhorar a confiabilidade do sistema.

- Participar da definição e implementação de políticas de segurança e conformidade.

- Ajudar na gestão de infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc.).

- Documentar processos, procedimentos e configurações de infraestrutura.


Requisitos:

- Experiência sólida em práticas de SRE e DevOps.

- Conhecimento em linguagens de programação e scripts (Python, Go, Bash, etc.).

- Experiência com ferramentas de automação de infraestrutura (Terraform, Puppet, Chef, Ansible, etc.).

- Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, etc.).

- Experiência em ambientes de nuvem (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc.).

- Conhecimento em contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Habilidade em solucionar problemas e trabalhar de forma independente.

- Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.


Diferenciais:

- Experiência em gestão de incidentes e resposta a emergências.

- Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

- Certificações relevantes (AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer, etc.).

- Familiaridade com práticas de segurança em DevOps (DevSecOps).

● Have a keen eye: naturally notice design, imagery, and visual trends in everyday life and social media; are interested in youth culture and what’s trending locally.

● A background in design, art, visual communication, or digital media arts.

● Have hands-on experience in graphic design, UI/UX, video editing, or photography.

● Are part of design clubs, competitions, or create visual content yourself.

Co-creation & Growth

● Workshops on social media, product, or design

Job Title: Clinical Statistical Programmer (SAS / CDISC)

Location - Brazil (Remote)


Role Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented Clinical Statistical Programmer to support clinical trial data standardization, analysis, and regulatory submissions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in CDISC standards (SDTM & ADaM), SAS programming, and generation of Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs), along with experience in quality control and submission readiness.

Transform raw clinical trial data into CDISC-compliant SDTM and ADaM datasets

Write efficient, well-documented SAS programs for data cleaning, derivations, and reporting

Develop reusable Python or R scripts for automation, validation, and reproducible reporting

Perform programming QC and peer reviews to ensure accuracy and traceability

Prepare and maintain programming specifications, mapping documents, and annotated CRFs

Troubleshoot complex data integration and derivation issues

Support audits and regulatory inspections with reproducible code and documentation

Required Qualifications

Strong experience with SAS programming

Hands-on experience with CDISC standards (SDTM & ADaM)

Experience generating TLFs for regulatory submissions

Knowledge of clinical trial data structures and submission processes

Familiarity with Python or R for automation (preferred)

Strong attention to detail and documentation practices

Preferred

Experience supporting FDA/EMA regulatory submissions

Prior experience in a Pharma, Biotech, or CRO environment

title: P&C Insurance Claims Expert
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.


Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil


POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing

As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.

  • Innovate: You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
  • Learn and Share: You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You’ll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team’s evolution.
  • Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations: You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
  • Act Across the Project Value Chain: From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
  • Participate in Training: You’ll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
  • Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team: You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.

What we are looking for

  • Academic Background: In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
  • Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
  • Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
  • Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem : Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
  • Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit : You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: P&C Insurance Claims Expert
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.


Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil


POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Engenheiro de Exchange
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Principais responsabilidades técnicas:

  • Migração de Exchange On-Premises para Microsoft Exchange Online
  • Projetos e upgrades de Microsoft Exchange Server (2010, 2013, 2016, 2019)
  • Configuração híbrida, fluxo de e-mail (SMTP), DAG, alta disponibilidade e disaster recovery

  • Scripting avançado em PowerShell

A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Auxiliar a coordenação no desenvolvimento e acompanhamento dos novos projetos e expansões, bem como garantir o andamento e controle de informações do departamento, por meio de pesquisas de legislação e acompanhamento dos projetos.

Superior Completo em Arquitetura;

Mobilidade para viagens.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Engenharia de Dados AWS Sênior - ID

Contribuir com a arquitetura e design de sistemas de grande porte, visando soluções robustas e eficientes. Colaborar ativamente em todas as fases do desenvolvimento de software, desde a concepção até a implementação e manutenção. Experiência em integração de APIs RESTful, microserviços e sistemas distribuídos. Sólidos conhecimentos de bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis). Experiência com testes automatizados (pytest, unittest) e ferramentas de integração contínua (Jenkins, GitLab CI). Experiência em ambientes de cloud computing, como AWS, Google Cloud ou Azure. Conhecimento de práticas de segurança em desenvolvimento de software. Familiaridade com containerização (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes). Habilidade de trabalhar em equipe e boa comunicação para interagir com áreas multidisciplinares. Capacidade de analisar e resolver problemas complexos de forma eficiente.

  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

Um profissional que atue bem em equipe e possua boa comunicação.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Mojo Trek, an Inc. 5000 company, delivers an unparalleled recruitment experience, grounded in transparency and integrity. From midsize technology innovators to Fortune 50 powerhouse corporations, we help our clients build technology teams that make a difference, push the change forward, and develop software critical to their success.


The Observability Enabler


The DevOps Engineer at Mojo Trek is a specialized \"Platform Architect\" who operates as a part-time strategic member of the Elite Squad. Rather than being a bottleneck for deployments, you are an Educator and Guardrail-Builder. You empower the \"Golden Three\" by setting up automated CI/CD pipelines, enforcing security/compliance standards, and enabling the deep observability (DORA/DX) that defines Mojo Trek’s success.


Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Design and maintain reproducible environments that adhere to specific platform standards and patterns.
  • Pipeline Orchestration: Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines that automate testing, security scanning, and deployment.
  • Observability Enablement: Own the tooling and instrumentation (logging, tracing, metrics) that allows Developers and POs to understand system health in real-time.
  • Governance & Compliance: Ensure the solution meets all security and regulatory requirements from day one.
  • Technical Education: Upskill the Software Engineers and Testers to manage their own containerization and basic deployment scripts, reducing hand-offs.


Qualifications

  • Platform Expert: Deep mastery of AWS, Azure, or GCP, specifically regarding container orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS) and serverless architectures.
  • Automation-First: Proficiency in Terraform, Pulumi, or similar IaC tools.
  • Security Mindset: Experience with DevSecOps practices, including secret management and vulnerability scanning.
  • Consultative Mentor: The ability to simplify complex infrastructure concepts for the rest of the team and the client stakeholders.


RACI Profile: The Platform Enabler

  • Accountable (A): CI/CD Pipeline Stability, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) standards, and Security Compliance.
  • Responsible (R): Observability setup, Cloud resource provisioning, and developer environment automation.
  • Consulted (C): Scale/Performance planning (PE) and disaster recovery strategy.
  • Informed (I): Sprint-level feature releases and routine bug fixes.

title: Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

“Estamos buscando um Engenheiro Sênior de Automação de Mainframe experiente para liderar a migração e otimização de soluções de automação em mainframe. Esta função tem como foco a transição do CA OPS/MVS para o IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e do CA Automation Point para o IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) .

O candidato ideal terá um papel crítico para garantir a eficiência operacional, a disponibilidade dos sistemas e processos de automação contínuos em um ambiente z/OS complexo.

Você irá colaborar de perto com a equipe de Automação para implementar soluções de automação baseadas em políticas, reduzir a sobrecarga administrativa e aumentar a capacidade de resposta dos sistemas. Esta posição não impacta o desenvolvimento de aplicações, mas influencia significativamente as estratégias e operações de automação.”


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar projetos de migração de CA OPS/MVS para IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e de CA Automation Point para IBM SAIOM.
  • Configurar e implementar soluções IBM Systems Automation, incluindo automação baseada em políticas para ambientes z/OS.
  • Desenvolver e manter regras de automação, execs REXX e configurações do System Automation Policy Database (PDB) .
  • Prestar suporte na instalação e configuração de produtos de automação da IBM.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de operações para otimizar processos de inicialização, desligamento e recuperação dos sistemas.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade e eficiência dos sistemas críticos por meio de estratégias proativas de automação.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e etapas de migração, garantindo comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Identificar e resolver problemas relacionados à automação em ambientes de produção.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • Experiência em Operações de Mainframe: Mínimo de 5+ anos em ambiente de operações de mainframe, em funções operacionais, de serviços, consultoria ou suporte.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Conhecimento avançado e experiência prática.
  • CA OPS/MVS: Avançado.
  • TSO e ISPF: Proficiência no uso dessas ferramentas para gerenciamento de sistemas.
  • JCL: Fortes habilidades em Job Control Language.
  • Programação REXX: Capacidade de escrever e manter scripts REXX.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Conhecimento prático obrigatório.
  • Experiência em Migração: Histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de automação em z/OS.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experiência na implementação e utilização deste produto.
  • Scripting REXX: Avançado.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • Conhecimento de outros softwares IBM Z, incluindo operação, configuração e automação de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com processos de inicialização e desligamento do sistema z/OS.
  • Experiência com SMP/E para instalação e manutenção de software.
  • Entendimento de produtos de automação concorrentes no ecossistema de mainframe.
  • Especialização em configurações de sistemas totalmente automatizados em IBM Z.

description:
Somos a Ōner Travel, uma solução completa do ecossistema BeFly para agentes que desejam ter uma plataforma online de vendas. Temos um time apaixonado por viagens e tecnologia, além da solução inteligente, responsável por unir essas duas paixões em uma experiência única, fácil e eficiente.

  • Garantir qualidade, segurança, performance e escalabilidade das soluções.

  • Experiência sólida como desenvolvedor(a) full stack (mínimo de 5 anos);

  • Experiência com Angular e React no front-end;
  • Vivência com Node.js no backend;• Conhecimento em arquitetura de software e boas práticas (DDD, desacoplamento, escalabilidade);
  • Experiência com sistemas de mensageria e comunicação assíncrona (SQS, RabbitMQ, Kafka etc.) em arquiteturas de microsserviços;
  • Experiência com integrações via APIs REST e WebServices;
  • Testes unitários e de integração;
  • Vivência com AWS;
  • Familiaridade com Azure Boards ou ferramentas similares de gestão ágil.

Buscamos alguém proativo, comprometido, flexível, resiliente, comunicativo e colaborativo.

Uma pessoa que goste de desafios, tenha curiosidade técnica, vontade de aprender e que não se limite apenas a executar — mas que também pense, questione e ajude a construir soluções melhores junto com o time!

description:
Na Printi, acreditamos que cada detalhe faz a diferença, mas o que realmente importa é você, independente de sua origem, identidade ou crenças!

Venha fazer parte dessa história de sucesso e inovação, com um ambiente de trabalho e soluções que celebram a diversidade e promovem a igualdade. A Printi é grande e, com você, seremos ainda maiores!

  • Colaborar com PMs, Designers e QAs desde a concepção, ajudando a transformar objetivos de produto em decisões técnicas viáveis, claras e sustentáveis.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento técnico do time, apoiando na mentoria de pessoas desenvolvedoras e fortalecendo a autonomia e consistência da squad.
  • Garantir visibilidade e organização do trabalho técnico, mantendo a documentação essencial e promovendo o compartilhamento de conhecimento.
  • Propor e acompanhar melhorias contínuas de arquitetura, ferramentas e processos que aumentem a qualidade, estabilidade e eficiência do time.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Desenvolvedor Wordpress
description:
Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor PHP + WordPress Pleno para atuar na manutenção e evolução de um plugin personalizado para WordPress, utilizado em uma aplicação de alta escala que atende mais de 150 mil usuários ativos. Nosso ecossistema é integrado com BuddyBoss e LearnDash, e o profissional terá contato com desafios reais de performance, escalabilidade e otimização.


Essa é uma excelente oportunidade para quem já domina o desenvolvimento de plugins WordPress e quer evoluir trabalhando em projetos robustos, com alto volume de acessos e dados.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Implementar novas funcionalidades no plugin personalizado em conjunto com a equipe.
  • Realizar manutenção corretiva e evolutiva, garantindo a estabilidade do sistema.
  • Contribuir para a otimização de código e performance em ambientes de alto tráfego.
  • Garantir compatibilidade com as versões mais recentes do WordPress, BuddyBoss e LearnDash.
  • Apoiar na otimização de consultas em banco de dados para lidar com grandes volumes de dados.
  • Seguir boas práticas de segurança para proteger informações sensíveis.
  • Integrar o plugin com APIs REST.
  • Colaborar com a equipe utilizando Git e metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

  • Experiência sólida com PHP e WordPress Development.
  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento e manutenção de plugins WordPress.
  • Conhecimento prático em BuddyBoss e LearnDash.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL, MariaDB), incluindo consultas otimizadas.
  • Vivência com versionamento de código (Git).
  • Conhecimento em integração de APIs REST.
  • Noções de segurança em aplicações WordPress.
  • Experiência em testes e debugging.

title: Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

“Estamos buscando um Engenheiro Sênior de Automação de Mainframe experiente para liderar a migração e otimização de soluções de automação em mainframe. Esta função tem como foco a transição do CA OPS/MVS para o IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e do CA Automation Point para o IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) .

O candidato ideal terá um papel crítico para garantir a eficiência operacional, a disponibilidade dos sistemas e processos de automação contínuos em um ambiente z/OS complexo.

Você irá colaborar de perto com a equipe de Automação para implementar soluções de automação baseadas em políticas, reduzir a sobrecarga administrativa e aumentar a capacidade de resposta dos sistemas. Esta posição não impacta o desenvolvimento de aplicações, mas influencia significativamente as estratégias e operações de automação.”


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar projetos de migração de CA OPS/MVS para IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e de CA Automation Point para IBM SAIOM.
  • Configurar e implementar soluções IBM Systems Automation, incluindo automação baseada em políticas para ambientes z/OS.
  • Desenvolver e manter regras de automação, execs REXX e configurações do System Automation Policy Database (PDB) .
  • Prestar suporte na instalação e configuração de produtos de automação da IBM.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de operações para otimizar processos de inicialização, desligamento e recuperação dos sistemas.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade e eficiência dos sistemas críticos por meio de estratégias proativas de automação.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e etapas de migração, garantindo comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Identificar e resolver problemas relacionados à automação em ambientes de produção.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • Experiência em Operações de Mainframe: Mínimo de 5+ anos em ambiente de operações de mainframe, em funções operacionais, de serviços, consultoria ou suporte.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Conhecimento avançado e experiência prática.
  • CA OPS/MVS: Avançado.
  • TSO e ISPF: Proficiência no uso dessas ferramentas para gerenciamento de sistemas.
  • JCL: Fortes habilidades em Job Control Language.
  • Programação REXX: Capacidade de escrever e manter scripts REXX.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Conhecimento prático obrigatório.
  • Experiência em Migração: Histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de automação em z/OS.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experiência na implementação e utilização deste produto.
  • Scripting REXX: Avançado.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • Conhecimento de outros softwares IBM Z, incluindo operação, configuração e automação de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com processos de inicialização e desligamento do sistema z/OS.
  • Experiência com SMP/E para instalação e manutenção de software.
  • Entendimento de produtos de automação concorrentes no ecossistema de mainframe.
  • Especialização em configurações de sistemas totalmente automatizados em IBM Z.

title: Operations Associate - Fluent in English
description:
Operations Associate | Remote (Brazil) | U.S. Market


At Blue Dot BPO , we support U.S.-based companies in building efficient, scalable, and results-driven operations. We are looking for an Operations Associate who is analytical, highly organized, and has a strong sense of ownership to support and optimize critical operational processes in a dynamic, fully remote environment, working directly with the U.S. market.


This is a strategic position for professionals who want to grow in operations, project management, and business analysis while working closely with leadership and cross-functional teams.


What We Offer

  • Fixed pay of R$5,000
  • Full-time Brazil contract
  • 100% remote , working directly with the U.S. market
  • Work schedule: 1 PM to 10 PM (BRT)
  • Long-term contract with growth opportunities
  • International, multicultural, and performance-driven environment


Your Responsibilities

  • Support the analysis and optimization of operational processes across departments
  • Map workflows, identify bottlenecks, and propose improvements (SOPs and best practices)
  • Support and/or manage cross-department projects, ensuring deadlines and deliverables
  • Act as a point of contact between operations, leadership, and stakeholders
  • Create operational reports, data analysis, and performance indicators (KPIs)
  • Support strategic decision-making with data and actionable insights
  • Ensure proper organization of documentation, processes, and internal communication


What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Engineering, or related fields
  • Fluent English (daily interaction with U.S.-based teams and stakeholders)
  • Previous experience in operations, business analysis, or project coordination
  • Experience working with U.S.-based companies
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (pivot tables, formulas)
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work with multiple stakeholders


Nice to Have

  • Experience with project management tools (Asana, Trello, ClickUp)
  • Knowledge of Business Intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau)
  • Experience in startups or fast-paced environments


Work directly with the U.S. market and grow your career in an environment that values ownership, structure, and results.


Apply now and become part of Blue Dot BPO.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

“Estamos buscando um Engenheiro Sênior de Automação de Mainframe experiente para liderar a migração e otimização de soluções de automação em mainframe. Esta função tem como foco a transição do CA OPS/MVS para o IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e do CA Automation Point para o IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) .

O candidato ideal terá um papel crítico para garantir a eficiência operacional, a disponibilidade dos sistemas e processos de automação contínuos em um ambiente z/OS complexo.

Você irá colaborar de perto com a equipe de Automação para implementar soluções de automação baseadas em políticas, reduzir a sobrecarga administrativa e aumentar a capacidade de resposta dos sistemas. Esta posição não impacta o desenvolvimento de aplicações, mas influencia significativamente as estratégias e operações de automação.”


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar projetos de migração de CA OPS/MVS para IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e de CA Automation Point para IBM SAIOM.
  • Configurar e implementar soluções IBM Systems Automation, incluindo automação baseada em políticas para ambientes z/OS.
  • Desenvolver e manter regras de automação, execs REXX e configurações do System Automation Policy Database (PDB) .
  • Prestar suporte na instalação e configuração de produtos de automação da IBM.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de operações para otimizar processos de inicialização, desligamento e recuperação dos sistemas.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade e eficiência dos sistemas críticos por meio de estratégias proativas de automação.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e etapas de migração, garantindo comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Identificar e resolver problemas relacionados à automação em ambientes de produção.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • Experiência em Operações de Mainframe: Mínimo de 5+ anos em ambiente de operações de mainframe, em funções operacionais, de serviços, consultoria ou suporte.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Conhecimento avançado e experiência prática.
  • CA OPS/MVS: Avançado.
  • TSO e ISPF: Proficiência no uso dessas ferramentas para gerenciamento de sistemas.
  • JCL: Fortes habilidades em Job Control Language.
  • Programação REXX: Capacidade de escrever e manter scripts REXX.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Conhecimento prático obrigatório.
  • Experiência em Migração: Histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de automação em z/OS.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experiência na implementação e utilização deste produto.
  • Scripting REXX: Avançado.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • Conhecimento de outros softwares IBM Z, incluindo operação, configuração e automação de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com processos de inicialização e desligamento do sistema z/OS.
  • Experiência com SMP/E para instalação e manutenção de software.
  • Entendimento de produtos de automação concorrentes no ecossistema de mainframe.
  • Especialização em configurações de sistemas totalmente automatizados em IBM Z.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack Sênior
description:
Somos a Ōner Travel, uma solução completa do ecossistema BeFly para agentes que desejam ter uma plataforma online de vendas. Temos um time apaixonado por viagens e tecnologia, além da solução inteligente, responsável por unir essas duas paixões em uma experiência única, fácil e eficiente.


O que nos move é certeza de que juntos criamos caminhos além do imaginável.

Venha com a gente!


Sobre a vaga


Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior, com forte visão de arquitetura e inovação, que tenha base sólida na nossa stack atual (C#, .NET e Angular), mas também repertório em outras tecnologias como Node.js e React, para nos ajudar a evoluir, modernizar e repensar partes do sistema.


É uma posição hands-on, mas com espaço real para influenciar decisões técnicas, apoiar o time e ajudar a desenhar os próximos passos da plataforma.


Principais responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver novas funcionalidades e evoluir produtos e códigos já existentes;
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time, apoiando na padronização de boas práticas;
  • Mapear, propor e apoiar a reestruturação de arquitetura;
  • Implementar e validar POCs (provas de conceito) de novas tecnologias e soluções;
  • Contribuir para decisões de inovação e definição tecnológica junto ao Tech Lead e demais desenvolvedores;
  • Garantir qualidade, segurança, performance e escalabilidade das soluções.


Requisitos técnicos


  • Experiência sólida como desenvolvedor(a) full stack (mínimo de 5 anos);
  • Forte conhecimento em C#, .NET e SQL Server;
  • Experiência com Angular e React no front-end;
  • Vivência com Node.js no backend;• Conhecimento em arquitetura de software e boas práticas (DDD, desacoplamento, escalabilidade);
  • Experiência com sistemas de mensageria e comunicação assíncrona (SQS, RabbitMQ, Kafka etc.) em arquiteturas de microsserviços;
  • Experiência com integrações via APIs REST e WebServices;
  • Testes unitários e de integração;
  • Vivência com AWS;
  • Familiaridade com Azure Boards ou ferramentas similares de gestão ágil.


Perfil comportamental


Buscamos alguém proativo, comprometido, flexível, resiliente, comunicativo e colaborativo.

Uma pessoa que goste de desafios, tenha curiosidade técnica, vontade de aprender e que não se limite apenas a executar — mas que também pense, questione e ajude a construir soluções melhores junto com o time!


Quais os benefícios de ser BeFly?


  • VR Ifood benefícios | Para que você se alimente bem.
  • Vale-transporte | Para facilitar sua locomoção.
  • Assistência médica Bradesco | Mensalidade 100% paga pela BeFly ao colaborador titular e 50% para dependentes, com coparticipação.
  • Seguro de vida | Sem custo para o colaborador.
  • Assistência odontológica | OdontoPrev.
  • Wellhub | Para você cuidar da sua saúde física.
  • Day off de aniversário | Um dia de descanso no seu aniversário.
  • Programa de maternidade | Pacote com diversos cuidados para uma gestação tranquila.
  • Programa Oriente-me | Sessões de terapia sem custo adicional.
  • Convênios educacionais | Descontos em instituições de ensino parceiras.
  • BeFlyers Travel | Agência de lazer interna com condições especiais para colaboradores.

title: Devops Engineer (Projeto Internacional)
description:
Se você busca uma oportunidade na área de Tecnologia da Informação, tem organização, boa comunicação e vontade de crescer, essa vaga 100% remoto e CLT, pode ser para você.

  • Experiência sólida com DevOps atuando com Saas/PaaS e plataformas de serviços;
  • Experiência com CI/CD, plataforma Azure (Kubernetes / SQL / AppGW / Key Vault);
  • Experiência com Jira e distribuição Linux;
  • Experiência com suporte operacional por meio de solução de problemas e análise de erros, garantindo o registro e monitoramento eficientes e solução de problemas confiável;

Se você busca uma oportunidade na área de Tecnologia da Informação, tem organização, boa comunicação e vontade de crescer, essa vaga 100% remoto e CLT, pode ser para você.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida com DevOps atuando com Saas/PaaS e plataformas de serviços;
  • Experiência com CI/CD, plataforma Azure (Kubernetes / SQL / AppGW / Key Vault);
  • Experiência com Jira e distribuição Linux;
  • Experiência com suporte operacional por meio de solução de problemas e análise de erros, garantindo o registro e monitoramento eficientes e solução de problemas confiável;
  • Idioma Inglês Avançado (terá inteirações internacionais).


Responsabilidades:

Esse profissional será responsável por provisionar, configurar e manter ambientes em nuvem, utilizando ferramentas (principalmente plataforma Azure) para garantir escalabilidade, estabilidade e segurança dos sistemas.

Além disso, é essencial o domínio em administração de sistemas Linux, com conhecimento em roteamento, estratégias de firewall e gestão de certificados. O profissional também atuará no suporte operacional, realizando análises de erros e troubleshooting, assegurando que os ambientes estejam corretamente logados, monitorados e performando de forma eficiente. Ter conhecimento ou interesse em práticas de CI/CD é valorizado, assim como disposição para trabalhar com ferramentas colaborativas como SharePoint e Jira.

Buscamos alguém com perfil proativo, analítico e orientado à automação, que contribua ativamente para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da infraestrutura


O que oferecemos:

  • Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.
  • Pacote de benefícios completo - PLR, VR, Gympass, Previdência, Convênios, etc.

title: Tech Lead
description:
Na Printi, acreditamos que cada detalhe faz a diferença, mas o que realmente importa é você, independente de sua origem, identidade ou crenças!


Somos uma empresa composta por um time diverso e inclusivo de pessoas #Printers, sempre prontas para transformar ideias em realidade gráfica. Valorizamos a pluralidade e buscamos proporcionar soluções para negócios de todos os tamanhos e segmentos, atendendo de pequenos empreendedores a grandes corporações.


Desde 2012, atuamos no mercado brasileiro com o investimento e a expertise do grupo Cimpress, líder global em customização em massa. Com um portfólio extenso, tecnologia de ponta, preços competitivos e prazos rápidos, oferecemos mais do que produtos: oferecemos confiança, respeito e parcerias duradouras.


Venha fazer parte dessa história de sucesso e inovação, com um ambiente de trabalho e soluções que celebram a diversidade e promovem a igualdade. A Printi é grande e, com você, seremos ainda maiores!


Responsabilidades :


  • Atuar como referência técnica da squad, orientando o time na definição de soluções, revisão de código e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Garantir o andamento das entregas técnicas, organizando prioridades com o time e acompanhando o progresso junto ao PM, antecipando riscos e removendo impedimentos.
  • Colaborar com PMs, Designers e QAs desde a concepção, ajudando a transformar objetivos de produto em decisões técnicas viáveis, claras e sustentáveis.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento técnico do time, apoiando na mentoria de pessoas desenvolvedoras e fortalecendo a autonomia e consistência da squad.
  • Garantir visibilidade e organização do trabalho técnico, mantendo a documentação essencial e promovendo o compartilhamento de conhecimento.
  • Propor e acompanhar melhorias contínuas de arquitetura, ferramentas e processos que aumentem a qualidade, estabilidade e eficiência do time.


Requisitos :


  • Formação superior em Ciências da Computação, Sistema de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos como Tech Lead.
  • Vivência em times orientados a produto


Benefícios :


  • Plano médico e odontológico Amil para cuidar de você e sua família;
  • Vale alimentação/refeição, disponibilizado num cartão flexível;
  • Auxilio Home Office;
  • Day off no dia do seu aniversário, para celebrar seu dia especial como merece;
  • Participação nos lucros e resultados;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Total pass, para garantir um estilo de vida saudável e equilibrado, para você e seus dependentes;
  • Vittude: 40% de desconto em sessões de psicoterapia online;
  • Desconto de 20% nos produtos da Printi para você aproveitar.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Location: Remote (LATAM only)

Contract: Full-time (40h/week)

Compensation: USD $12,000 – $14,000 gross per year (depending on experience)

Languages: Fluent English required, with familiarity in French

Seniority: 3+ years in B2B SaaS Customer Support

Start Date: ASAP


We’re hiring a Customer Support Specialist with strong technical capabilities to help us deliver high-quality, reliable support at scale.


At FullEnrich, support is central to the product experience. Our customers rely on our data for revenue-generating workflows. That means our responses must be accurate, structured, and genuinely helpful, not just fast.


About FullEnrich

FullEnrich helps businesses find accurate emails and phone numbers to reach the right people.


Unlike most enrichment tools that rely on a single source, FullEnrich aggregates 20+ data providers into a waterfall system that automatically tests multiple sources to return the best available contact data.


We are a profitable B2B data platform used by 3,000+ customers, with around 2,000 new signups every week. Our product supports sales, recruiting, marketing, and operations teams worldwide.


We’re a remote-first team of 20+ people across the US, UK, and Europe. We value ownership, clarity, and high standards in how we work.


What You’ll Do

  • Respond to customer questions via Intercom (chat & email) and Slack
  • Troubleshoot product, billing, and account-related issues
  • Help customers troubleshoot API requests, bulk CSV uploads, credit usage questions, and external tool integrations (e.g. HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier)
  • Investigate issues using internal documentation and tools before escalating
  • Manage multiple real-time conversations while maintaining clarity and quality
  • Escalate bugs with clear context and reproducible steps
  • Improve internal documentation when gaps are identified


We value thoughtful problem-solving. Clear explanations matter as much as technical accuracy.


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS customer support
  • Strong understanding of APIs, external tool integrations, and bulk data uploads (CSV)
  • Comfortable troubleshooting technical issues independently
  • Excellent written English
  • French familiarity required; fluency not necessary
  • Experience with Intercom or similar support tools
  • Structured, calm, and reliable in real-time chat environments
  • Based in LATAM time zones


Why Work at FullEnrich

  • Profitable and growing with strong product-market fit
  • A small team where your work has visible impact
  • Remote-first and internationally distributed
  • A support culture focused on quality, clarity, and accountability


If you take pride in delivering exceptional support and enjoy solving technical problems thoroughly, we’d be happy to hear from you.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Software Backend - Sênior (Go & Type)
description:
O que você precisa para essa posição no jogo:

  • Conhecimento avançado em desenvolvimento em Golang ou Typescript ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de consumidores e produtores de eventos para Event Streaming (Kafka) ;
  • Conhecimento em Docker & Kubernetes ;
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade ;
  • Conhecimento sobre testes unitários e de integração;
  • Preocupação com a qualidade e desempenho das soluções propostas;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente multifuncional e colaborativo, de maneira autônoma;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento e implementação de APIs ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de microsserviços distribuídos ;
  • Embasamento teórico, habilidade e preocupação com a excelência técnica e boas práticas de desenvolvimento (DDD, Arquitetura, Design de Código, Paradigmas, etc.);

Seria legal se você conhecesse:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento em C# ;
  • Google Cloud Continuous Integration;
  • Continuous Delivery.


O seu papel como Software Engineering Backend:

  • Desenvolver programação do início ao fim, incluindo definições de arquitetura, testes e rollout em produção;
  • Desenvolvimento de projetos com arquitetura de microserviços, consumo e geração de eventos em Streaming, API's;
  • Garantir a funcionalidade, manutenibilidade e velocidade, além de práticas de teste e qualidade;
  • Garantir que todas as soluções técnicas estejam alinhadas a estratégia do negócio e entender iniciativas relacionadas ao produto;

  • Trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo, em que práticas de pareamento, feedbacks e motivação para se desenvolver são comuns a todos os squads.
